fund_name: The Fund for the Advancement of Medicine
summary: Provides grants to scientifically active clinics, laboratories and institutions for projects including operating expenses (test materials), laboratory remuneration, procurement of small appliances, and payment of non-scientific labor. Research year projects typically have limited support. Applicants must be fully funded during the project period. Applications must be sent by signed and dated letter; there are no application forms, no email applications, and no deadlines. Response time varies. Further information can be requested by the Fund.
